@@ -34,6 +34,10 @@ jobs:
       - name: Build
         run: go build -v ./cmd/gh
 
+      - name: Build with debug overrides
+        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
+        run: go build -v -tags=ghdebug ./cmd/gh
+
   integration-tests:
     env:
       GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

@@ -16,6 +16,11 @@ endif
 bin/gh$(EXE): script/build$(EXE)
 	@script/build$(EXE) $@
 
+# Builds bin/gh with the ghdebug build tag, which enables the GH_INTERNAL_* overrides in internal/debug.
+.PHONY: debug
+debug: script/build$(EXE)
+	@GO_BUILDTAGS=ghdebug script/build$(EXE) bin/gh$(EXE)
+
 script/build$(EXE): script/build.go
 ifeq ($(EXE),)
 	GOOS= GOARCH= GOARM= GOFLAGS= CGO_ENABLED= go build -o $@ $<

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+//go:build !ghdebug
+
+package debug
+
+// Enabled reports whether gh was built with the ghdebug build tag.
+const Enabled = false
+
+// Config reads internal debug overrides from the environment.
+// Without the ghdebug build tag it ignores the environment and returns a DebugConfig with no overrides set.
+// In debug builds, invalid environment values cause a panic.
+func Config() DebugConfig {
+	return DebugConfig{}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+//go:build !ghdebug
+
+package debug_test
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/cli/cli/v2/internal/debug"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+)
+
+func TestConfigIgnoresEnvironment(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, value := range []string{"1", "invalid"} {
+		t.Run(value, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Setenv("GH_INTERNAL_AT_EXPIRES_IN", value)
+			t.Setenv("GH_INTERNAL_RT_EXPIRES_IN", value)
+			t.Setenv("GH_INTERNAL_DEBUG_REFRESH_TOKEN", value)
+
+			assert.Equal(t, debug.DebugConfig{}, debug.Config())
+		})
+	}
+}
